strengths: Real-time NDJSON / SSE streaming provides smooth token rendering with live spinner indicators.
Health status bar in the header accurately reflects live connectivity across all four system tiers (API, SQLite, ChromaDB, Ollama).
Source citation cards provide excellent auditability, including document name, page number, chunk index, and cosine distance score chips.
Unanswerable queries cleanly trigger the insufficient context fallback without hallucinating facts outside the indexed corpus.
Adaptive Evidence Assembly abstains gracefully when cosine distance exceeds the relevance threshold, saving significant inference time.
automation_pitfalls_identified: Playwright selector strictness: 'button:has-text("+ New chat")' matches two elements (desktop sidebar and mobile header). Automated scripts must qualify with '>> nth=0' or use explicit ARIA roles.
Chat input element type: The input field is an '<input type="text">' rather than a '<textarea>'. Automation scripts targeting 'textarea' fail unless updated.

Windows Job Object subshell lifecycle: Background daemon processes spawned by 'playwright-cli open' on Windows are tied to the parent PowerShell process tree and terminate when individual subshell commands exit unless invoked within a persistent process group.

performance_benchmarks.local_llm_inference: qwen3:4b on CPU/GPU takes approximately 100-160 seconds for 2048-token deep reasoning answers, but returns in under 3 seconds for abstention/unanswerable queries.
performance_benchmarks.retrieval_latency: Embedding lookup via ChromaDB (HNSW) executes in under 45ms across all 48 chunks.
